fixed_on: 2026-09-30, before the first protocol run; the criteria mirror static_drop_2d/tolerances.json. Revised on 2026-10-07 by decision D25 (gating level R/h = 16, order over 8/16, D19 time step and time-step criterion), before any D25 protocol run

levels.note: D25: R/h = 32 is not run (5.3 million tetrahedra; not affordable). generate_case.py can still write it.

protocol.laplace_numbers_note: D25 runs La = 12 only. generate_case.py writes the D19 static-drop step for La = 120 as well (dt = 0.01); that study is not part of D25.
protocol.time_step: Decision D25 (2026-10-07): the D19 static-drop protocol. The lagged normal-increment capillary term is on (Surface_tension_semi_implicit = NormalIncrement) and every level uses one fixed physical step, dt = 0.02 at La = 12 (618 steps at any R/h; the same physical end time, 12.36, as static_drop_2d). The output cadence is the nearest whole number of steps per 1/100 of the run, which ends at the first output at or after 5 viscous times. The R/h = 8 study is also run at dt/2 (generate_case.py --dt-divisor 2); see time_step_criterion.
protocol.time_step_before_D25: dt <= m * dt_B, dt_B = sqrt(rho*h^3/(4*pi*gamma)) = (1/sqrt(2)) * sqrt(rho*h^3/(2*pi*gamma)), rounded down so that the run is 100 equal output intervals; m = 2 at La = 12 and m = 1 at La = 120, taken from the 2D step-0 measurement (tracker M2, jobs 46075447 and 46076505). The 3D values of m are assumed from 2D and must be checked once in 3D (README.md). The gated metrics are relaxed steady-state values, so the time step does not enter them (decision D10). Reproduced by generate_case.py --dt-multiple <m> --surface-tension-semi-implicit None --kinematic-reconciliation off.
protocol.surface_tension_semi_implicit: NormalIncrement (decisions D13, D19, D25; None before D25)
protocol.kinematic_reconciliation: on (Enable_kinematic_reconciliation = true, decision D14; off before D25)
protocol.capillary_form: D25 gates SurfaceStress only (both KAG forms fail M2 in 2D); the criteria apply to any form.
protocol.transport: Level-set advection velocity (decision D9): pde_extension (harmonic PDE extension, monolithic coupling; the protocol transport), wet_extension and coupled for comparison. Criteria apply separately to each transport.
protocol.note: Criteria apply separately to each (capillary form, transport, Laplace number, dt divisor) refinement study, and must pass at dt and, where the dt/2 study has the level, at dt/2. See README.md for the definitions and the cost of each level.
protocol.note_before_D25: R/h = 32 (5.3 million tetrahedra, about 4,000 steps at La = 12) may not be affordable with the current per-step cost; without it the pressure-jump criterion cannot be evaluated (README.md, Expected cost per level).

criteria.definition: |(p_in - p_ext) - 2*gamma/R_eff| / (2*gamma/R_eff) at the end of the run. p_in is the volume-weighted mean of the P1 pressure over the tetrahedra lying entirely inside the ball of radius R_eff/2 about the liquid centroid; R_eff = (3V/(4*pi))^(1/3), V the exact volume of {phi_h < 0}.
criteria.order_method: least-squares slope of log(error) against log(R/h) over order_levels (with two levels, the pairwise order); pairwise orders are reported
criteria.source: Decision D25 (2026-10-07): pressure-jump error <= 1% at R/h = 16 with observed order >= 1 over R/h = 8/16. Before D25: the D1 working criterion of static_drop_2d (tracker section 5, M2: <= 1% at R/h = 32, order over 8/16/32).

criteria.definition: Ca_sp = mu * max|u_h| / gamma, max over the vertices with phi_h < 0, taking the largest value over the outputs in the final quarter of the run (t > 3T/4).
criteria.source: Decision D25 (2026-10-07): Ca_sp decreasing from R/h = 8 to 16, absolute values reported. Before D25: the decision of 2026-09-29 recorded in the tracker (section 5, M2), as for static_drop_2d: no absolute limit; the spurious flow must decrease strictly under refinement, and no_velocity_growth must hold.

criteria.definition: max|u_h| (liquid vertices) at the end of the run divided by the largest max|u_h| over the outputs in the third quarter of the run (T/2 <= t <= 3T/4). A ratio <= 1 means the final value lies within the envelope of the preceding quarter.
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M2: no growth of max|u| in time); kept by D25

criteria.definition: max over the run of |V(t) - V(0)| / V(0), with V the exact volume of {phi_h < 0} and V(0) that of the sampled initial level set in mesh/mesh-complete.mesh.vtu. The maximum is taken over all outputs and, when the solver log is present and its per-step wet volume matches the snapshot volume at every output to 1e-8, over every step of the log.
criteria.source: Decision D1 working criterion (tracker section 5, M2: volume drift <= 1e-4), measured as the maximum deviation over the run (decision D11); kept by D25

time_step_criterion.source: Decision D25 (2026-10-07), the D19 static-drop criterion (static_drop_2d/tolerances.json, design note Documentation/free_surface_semi_implicit_surface_tension_design.md, section 9.9): every gate that the dt/2 study can evaluate passes at both steps, and the pressure jump changes by at most 0.1% when the step is halved. The dt/2 run is made at R/h = 8 only (a dt/2 run at R/h = 16 would cost days; in 2D halving the step changed the pressure jump by 1.2e-10 at La = 12).
time_step_criterion.definition: |dp(dt) - dp(dt/2)| / |dp(dt/2)|, dp = p_in - p_ext as in pressure_jump, between the dt divisor 1 and 2 studies of one (capillary form, transport, Laplace number) at their finest common level.
time_step_criterion.at_level: finest common level of the dt and dt/2 studies (R/h = 8 under D25)
time_step_criterion.gates_at_each_step: every criterion applies to the dt study; the dt/2 study must contain the levels in refined_step_levels, and criteria that need other levels (pressure_jump at R/h = 16, the order and the Ca_sp decrease) are reported as not evaluated at dt/2
time_step_criterion.reported_note: Ca_sp is reported for each step (it depends on dt at coarse levels; design note section 9.8, risk 4).
time_step_criterion.when_one_divisor_only: reported as not evaluated; does not fail
